doc: Ch9 'The Ebbing', the end of Act I (M3-C09-02; docs/kb/story/beats/act1_ch09.md B01-B11; docs/kb/tech/chapter_flow.md 'Ch9'). One greybox zone, played by ZoneStory: ch09/corrow_night, a stand-in for the sheet's `ch08/corrow` night variant (built before Ch8; Ch8 hands off to it). ENTRY: Ch8's B18 hands off here with {"go": {"location": "ch09/corrow_night", "spawn": "Strand"}} (M3-C08-02); the zone's own locations.json row and the F5 teleport reach it too. Whether this block later moves to ch08/corrow as its night variant is M3-C09-04's call. B01 on arrival (the chapter becomes 9, the chapter autosave), then the strand: Marra's bark (ch09_heard_stair_clear), Liss's (needs ch08_hoist_cut_down), Hobb's and a Stillguard's overheard, and Toma, whose talk prompt (by the fire: the beat 'toma_talk' shows his body for the scene, then he follows again) plays the side scene 'Shield-Mate' (B02) while ch08_met_ivo is set and it hasn't played, else 'Not since the stair.' Walking onto the raft's landing runs the 'ebbing' beat: ONE scene, ch09_the_ebbing (B03 the gilt line; B04, B05 and B07, the three movements, each a no-fail held input between hold_input events, CutsceneHoldGate; B06 the stair cutaway; B08 Pell's first words and his joining), then the zone reloads at dawn at RoadGate (the layout's dawn variant: the party on the road, Kerrid at the milestone). Walking up the road to the milestone runs 'road_out': ONE scene, ch09_the_road_out (B09 'Somebody's still below.', Pell's name, the line with Kerrid last; a hard cut to B10, the Iskarra vigil and Rhen's VO; B11 the act card). EXIT: Ch10 (Act II) isn't in M3, so the act break hands off to the end card. Ch9 has no fight of any kind (rule 5) and no random encounters. Pell joins by flag (ch09_pell_joined): he has no battle row, so he is not in the party lists. Party: Rhen, Asha and Toma (on the night strand Asha and Toma follow Rhen; their stage bodies are hidden until the ebbing shows them: the Lead, 10-30, GPU QA row 39), with Kerrid and Ysolde in reserve (Liss has no battle row).
